experimental_method: Densities with a Sodev vibrating-tube densimeter and sound velocities with a Nusonics sing-around velocimeter; apparent molal volumes and compressibilities derived; temperatures controlled to +-0.005 C.
uncertainties_stated: Relative densities precise to 3 ppm, relative sound velocities to 6 ppm.
quality_remarks: Instruments calibrated with NaCl solutions using Desnoyers and Millero data. Authors note poorer Pitzer fits for CaCl2. Reference density d0 and the definition of y_b are not given in the tables or text; interpretations are recorded in the mappings as presumed. Pressure not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (Pitzer coefficients), Table IV (mixing parameters, RMSD), Table V (Pitzer coefficients for expansibility) and Table VI (mean apparent molal expansibilities, calculated from derived quantities) are fitted or derived and were not extracted.
